specifications.details: The building is designed with a robust Reinforced Cement Concrete (RCC) framed structural system, ensuring strength, stability, and durability.
Red brick masonry work executed using high-quality bricks laid in cement mortar, ensuring strength and durability.
Internal walls are finished with two coats of smooth plastering, while external surfaces receive two coats of plastering with waterproof cement compounds to enhance durability and weather resistance.
uPVC sliding window shutters are provided with mosquito mesh, a three-track system for smooth operation, and a painted MS safety grill fabricated from 10 mm square rods.

Doors are provided with African teakwood door frames of 4” × 3” section, fitted with 32 mm thick waterproof flush shutters finished with laminate on both sides. The doors are completed with reliable Europa lock fittings, ensuring durability, smooth operation, and long-term performance.

vitrified tiles of size 600 mm × 1200 mm are provided for the hall, bedrooms, dining area, kitchen, and balcony, offering a premium finish and uniform appearance. Anti-skid tiles are used in all toilets to ensure enhanced safety and slip resistance.

The kitchen is finished with a Khammam Black granite countertop, fitted with a stainless steel sink, and complemented by a wall tile dado up to 3 feet height above the countertop for durability, hygiene, and ease of maintenance.
All water pipelines with CPVC pipes, Truflo CPVC pipes for waste water and jaguar or Hindware Fittings. Diverters with faucets in the bathrooms.

This door system is constructed using African teakwood door frames with a finished section size of 5” × 3”, offering excellent strength, durability, and resistance to moisture and termites. fitted with 35 mm thick waterproof flush shutters finished with Teakwood veneer  on both sides. The doors are completed with reliable Europa lock fittings, ensuring durability, smooth operation, and long-term performance.

Internal walls are finished with Berger Paints Premier Emulsion over a smooth  White wall putty base, providing a refined and durable finish. The building elevation features texture paint for enhanced aesthetics, while all other exterior walls are coated with Berger Rain Guard, ensuring superior protection against weather and moisture.
Sanitary fittings of Jaquar or Hindware make are provided, including water closets (WC) for all toilets and a wash basin in the dining area.

Concealed PVC conduit wiring is provided using copper cables of Goldmedal Electricals make, along with Anchor modular switches and MCBs for enhanced safety and reliability. Adequate air-conditioner points are provided in all bedrooms, with geyser provisions in toilets. The kitchen is equipped with 15-amp power sockets for chimney, microwave oven, mixer grinder, and refrigerator. Provision is also made for lights, fans, calling bell, TV, telephone, internet, and intercom facilities, ensuring complete electrical convenience throughout the residence.

Escorts sound proofing generator, transformer, 3- phase power connection panel board, drainage and car parking area. Solar fencing system all around the compound wall. Railing at balconies and stair cases. Granite flooring in corridors and staircase.

Toilets are finished with anti-skid Concept ceramic tiles for flooring and Concept ceramic wall tiles up to 7 feet height (door top level). All toilet areas are treated with Fosroc waterproofing liquid, applied in two coats to ensure effective protection against water seepage and long-term durability.

Bore water for general usage is supplied through a central sump and overhead tanks. Hot water supply provisions are provided for the master bedroom and children’s toilets through geysers. A dedicated water purifier provision is provided above the kitchen sink for drinking water requirements.
A 6-passenger capacity lift is provided with  MS gate rail door closers and an inbuilt rescue device for enhanced safety and reliability.
